description: Bitter yellow root bark. A day and a night of being shown your own life, and a heart that may not agree to it.

effects.comeon_message: Bitter enough to close your throat. Your pulse picks up, then does something you don't like.

events.text: [trip]A dry buzzing takes you over, head to foot, and won't be shaken off.[/trip]
[trip]It begins at the beginning, which you didn't expect and can't look away from.[/trip]
[trip]You're shown something you did and the room waits for you to say something about it.[/trip]
[trip]A long, patient accounting. Nobody here is angry with you, and nobody looks away.[/trip]
[trip]Your heart does something irregular and the visions don't pause for it.[/trip]
[trip]It finishes. It doesn't offer a conclusion. You're simply let go.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: A dry electrical buzzing takes your whole body, and then your life begins playing back to you in order, with notes.

overdose.message: Your heart finds a rhythm it has never tried before, holds it a moment too long, and stops looking for the old one.

phases.comedown_message: The playback stops somewhere in the middle of a scene and does not resume.
phases.end_message: A day and a night of it, and you are still sitting in the same place, and your chest aches.

effects.take_line: You chew the bitter {name} bark down and swallow.

withdrawal.message: You keep waiting for it to finish telling you the thing. It stopped a while ago.

stages.easing: You stop reaching for it every few minutes.
stages.onset: The thread you were being shown goes slack.
stages.peak: It laid your whole life out and then left the room, and you're the only one here who saw it, and you can't get it back to check.
stages.rising: You keep waiting for it to finish telling you the thing. It stopped a while ago.
stages.tail: Whatever it showed you is yours now, unverified, and it isn't coming back to confirm anything.

name: ibogaine
